name: Vinyl & Leather Protectant

features.text: Resists cracking, staining, fading and discoloration.
Leaves a natural looking finish. PERFORMANCE RATING - Gloss - 5 • Durability - 10

description: A water-based liquid sealant containing long-lasting resins, U.V. inhibitors and protective compounds designed to preserve and beautify vinyl and finished leather on a car's interior.
application: Shake well before using. Never apply product to steering wheels, accelerator pedals, brake pedals and clutch pedals. Surface should be clean and dry. 1) Generously apply product to a sponge applicator and wipe surface in an overlapping 2) For best results, allow product to set and penetrate for 5-10 minutes. Buff off excess product with a soft, dry cloth or microfiber towel. 3) A second application may be applied added protection and improved appearance.
